monotonicity_rationale: Eliminate fixed massless fin and sealed-fluid states. Effective thermal K is a grounded M-matrix with K*1>=0; inverse of K+M/dz is nonnegative. BE deficits decrease downstream from theta_0=1. For diagonal M2>=M1, w_n=theta2_n-theta1_n satisfies (K+M2/dz)w_n=(M2/dz)w_(n-1)+(M2-M1)/dz*(theta1_(n-1)-theta1_n)>=0. Reconstruction of massless states is nonnegative. Nonnegative base boundary weights give integrated base heat G2>=G1. All active hydraulic U(P) strictly increase for K>=0. Retain numerical finite-bracket positive slopes as local evidence, not independent proof of continuous physical-model monotonicity.
